## Scope and base

Milestone/slices (or setup task), dependencies, expected base/head:

## Implementation and specification

Paper figures/guards, design decisions and preserved invariants:

## Actual verification evidence

Actual UTC date, source/tree, toolchain, Debug/Release commands and counts,
focused failure/replay tests, CI links (include failures and fixes):

## Independent review

Reviewer agent, scope, findings and dispositions, cycles used, remaining risks:
Agent review is not human approval or a correctness proof.

## History and safety

- [ ] Relevant changes only; no secrets/build artifacts/backups
- [ ] Published anchors unchanged; correct ancestry and commit metadata
- [ ] Historical dates explicitly reconstructed; actual evidence dated accurately
- [ ] No later milestone or unsupported correctness/performance claims

## User review needed

Architecture/timeline decisions, known limitations, and suggested next work.
Do not merge automatically.
